l.i: Versus gementes vt nouatoPectine rite lubens recantem.
Phœbus iocosæ carminibus lyræ,Veris volentem munera me loqui,Umbrásque syluarum virentes,Increpuit graviore plectro.

Ne læta, dixit, rura Fauonio,Ne blandientis delitias rosæ,Pronósque per riuos placenteCum strepitu salientis vndæIucunditatem nunc cytharæ modisAptare tentes, membra sub arbutoFlorente stratus recreanda,Gramineóve latens in antro.
Tam luctuoso gaudia temporeCuris solutum carpere fas vetat:Non visitati quum doloresPerniciem minitentur orbi.
Qualem prioris tempora sæculiSensere quondam, quum scelere impioPolluta gens humana grandemDiluuiem peritura vidit.
Tunc omne terris omnibus, heu, genusMortale tantis imbribus obrutum

page.notes: Verse is set in italic. Long s rendered as s. Some words in the scan are slightly blurred (e.g. "Pronósque", "Gramineóve") and are transcribed as printed; the "C." at lower right is a gathering signature.
